New decision "Canonical form for digests is compact JSON with recursively sorted keys, arrays in order, undefined dropped, UTF-8, no Unicode normalization; the digest covers the envelope minus digest and sig and is recomputed from the PARSED object so on-disk pretty-printing never matters; file bytes, canonical bytes and attachment source bytes are three distinct hashes" relates to:
- 01M2KCECC0ZY7SQHV70CG2ANYQ: "Evidence class is decided by the INGRESS that produced the event (ceremony/adapter/connector/mcp/cli/import/migration), validated before storage, never taken from a caller field; human_ruling is producible only by the signing ceremony or an import carrying a valid signature by a known HUMAN key"
